svg.title: Ankit Shrestha — Software Engineer | AI Enthusiast
svg.desc: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++. Tech stack — Frontend: HTML, CSS, Sass, Tailwind, Bootstrap, React, Next.js. Backend: Python, FastAPI, Starlette, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, JavaScript, Flask, C++. Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis. API and Communication: REST API, GraphQL, gRPC, Insomnia, Postman. DevOps and Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux, Bash.
